analytical_question: What adoption action is justified for this application over four weeks?
general_et_finding: Generative AI is established enough for assisted writing experiments. Controlled writing gains and observed worker use do not establish reliable extraction, matched product images or net savings in this workflow.
application_finding: Captions and layout drafts can be edited. A wrong unit, product revision or image may survive a fluent rewrite. Compare the existing manual Canva workflow with AI drafting plus the same technical review and retouching.
organization_specific_finding: The same approved archive exists, but the stated policy excludes real briefs until comparable outside evidence is available. Synthetic work remains permissible.

evidence.claim: Access to ChatGPT reduced average time by 40% on sampled professional writing tasks.
evidence.notes: No screenshot extraction, product verification or Canva comparison; do not transfer the effect size.

evidence.claim: About 45% of employed respondents reported using generative AI for their job in Q2 2026.
evidence.notes: Worker denominator, any job use; no evidence of peer deployment for this workflow.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: An archive experiment exceeds policy. Monitoring alone discards a permitted chance to find extraction errors.
Neither cited population measures accuracy or peer deployment of this end-to-end textile workflow.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence in the stated permission boundary; moderate confidence in the action conditional on case assumptions; net productivity and residual error rates unknown.
value_opportunity_implication: Net staff minutes per accepted draft determines relative advantage; fast first drafts alone can shift effort to the technical reviewer.
risk_governance_implication: Trace numbers and units to the current product sheet, match image IDs and prohibit automatic publication. Sustained reviewer staffing and training belong to the Organizational Adoption Agent.
recommendation_management_implication: Proof of concept. Within one week the creator makes three fictional product sheets with known units, revisions and image IDs. The reviewer checks AI and manual drafts against that key; keep the exercise internal.
change_monitoring_triggers: If all three synthetic outputs preserve every number, unit and image identity after review, record feasibility only. At week four the marketing lead reviews independent comparable workflow evidence before requesting an archive trial.
Stop for a real input or uncorrected mismatch. A synthetic pass alone cannot lift the archive restriction.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Request independent evidence from a comparable reviewed workflow and confirmation from the policy owner before proposing a representative trial.
